samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>Implement a 4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplicand.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="partial_products" width_description="[2*size-1:0]">Array to store partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="registers" width_description="[2*size-1:0]">Array to store intermediate sum values.</reg>
        <reg id="product" width_description="[2*size-1:0]">Product accumulator.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <!-- Multiplication operation -->
        <for>
            <from>0</from>
            <to>size-1</to>
            <step>1</step>
            <description>
                <assign>
                    <lhs>partial_products[i]</lhs>
                    <rhs>
                        <if>
                            <condition>mul_b[i]</condition>
                            <then>mul_a << i</then>
                            <else>'d0</else>
                        </if>
                    </rhs>
                </assign>
            </description>
        </for>
        <!-- Add of partial products -->
        <for>
            <from>0</from>
            <to>size/2-1</to>
            <step>1</step>
            <description>
                <always>
                    <sensitivity>
                        <posedge>clk</posedge>
                        <negedge>rst_n</negedge>
                    </sensitivity>
                    <if>
                        <condition>rst_n == 0</condition>
                        <then>
                            <assign>
                                <lhs>registers[i]</lhs>
                                <rhs>'d0</rhs>
                            </assign>
                        </then>
                        <else>
                            <assign>
                                <lhs>registers[i]</lhs>
                                <rhs>partial_products[2*i] + partial_products[2*i+1]</rhs>
                            </assign>
                        </else>
                    </if>
                </always>
            </description>
        </for>
        <!-- Final product calculation -->
        <always>
            <sensitivity>
                <posedge>clk</posedge>
                <negedge>rst_n</negedge>
            </sensitivity>
            <if>
                <condition>rst_n == 0</condition>
                <then>
                    <assign>
                        <lhs>product</lhs>
                        <rhs>'d0</rhs>
                    </assign>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <assign>
                        <lhs>product</lhs>
                        <rhs>registers</rhs>
                    </assign>
                </else>
            </if>
        </always>
        <!-- Output assignment -->
        <assign>
            <lhs>mul_out</lhs>
            <rhs>product</rhs>
        </assign>
    </implementation>
</module>
